intro: Bloodfen Burrow is a cavern in southwestern Dustwallow Marsh swarming with vicious raptors. The beasts have claimed the cave and the surrounding clearing, completely overrunning the ruins of a settlement that once tried to survive the wetlands.

p: Tucked away in the southwestern reaches of Dustwallow Marsh, Bloodfen Burrow serves as the primary den for the region's aggressive Bloodfen raptors. The cave mouth and surrounding hollow crawl with the pack, drawn to the sheltered crevice and the bountiful hunting ground the marsh provides. Just outside the entrance lie scattered debris and splintered remains of an unidentified settlement, serving as a grim reminder of who truly rules the swamp's interior. Travelers also whisper that Cortello, an adventurous buccaneer, left one of his hidden riddle clues somewhere within this deadly den.
